notes.title: 1.1.2 Released!
notes.content:
Upon playing the game once again after almost a year, there are a few bugs that we noticed and fixed immediately.

- Fixed a bug that prevents the discounts from appearing
- Fixed a bug where the snowy background is in front of the cat sprite

notes.title: 1.1.1 Is Released!
notes.content:
Game Collector 1.1.1 is released with new UX improvments and bug fixes!

Changes:
- Difficulty level is now displayed on the save files to avoid confusion
- A few days before the monthly payment, a warning will be displayed to inform the player about the payment
- Useful tips about the game over reason is displayed on the game over screen

Bug Fixes:
- In the janitor minigame, the light around the characters would not fade away on the game over screen. Now it disappears after a game over
- Color of the "E" button would stay green if the minigame ends while it was green. Now it turns back to the color it should be
- The weather in the second house would look cloudy even if it wasn't. Now it is displayed correctly
- All texts in the State Estate fits correctly now

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- "Game God" achievement could not be achieved, it is fixed now. If you have all the other 19 achievements, you should get the achievement once you open the game.
- Programming job salary wasn't multiplied with the difficulty money boost, so the beginner programmer job would pay as much as advanced. Now beginner pays x3 as it should.

- Not a bug, but a convenient change: The UI will be anchored to the top right corner when playing the taxi driver minigame, which makes it easier to see the road.

notes.title: Language bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug about the language of the game, which breaks most texts in the game for players who haven't set their computer's language to English(US) or Turkish, unless they change the language.
Also fixed some problems about Turkish localization (Some texts weren't translated).
